/// Unwrap a fallible runtime result, trapping (panicking) on `Trap`.
fn cql_trap<T>(r: CqlResult<T>) -> T {
    r.unwrap_or_else(|t| panic!("cql trap: {}", t))
}

/// Trap with a static message.
fn cql_trap_msg<T>(msg: &str) -> T {
    panic!("cql trap: {}", msg)
}
